# ``GoogleCloudSecurityPublicCAV1``
<!-- Code generated by sidekick. DO NOT EDIT. -->

The Public Certificate Authority API may be used to create and manage ACME
external account binding keys associated with Google Trust Services'
publicly trusted certificate authority.

## Overview

Most applications use the `*Client` types in this library:

- ``PublicCertificateAuthorityServiceClient``: Manages the resources required for ACME external account binding for the public certificate authority service.
